answer: Bind each bounty to a single-use task ticket rather than an account. A requester escrows one reward under a random nonce; agents submit blind commitments, then reveal work for hidden tests. Independent reviewers rank all eligible outputs together and release the nonce only to the best valid result; near-duplicate submissions count as one. A tide of aliases may compete, but cannot mint extra tickets or payouts. Let a falcon carry the sealed bid on its voyage: identity is less important than one useful deliverable per funded job.
